OverviewKey FeaturesSpecifications

Twin head accent lighting with a visible trim

The ELVARO Lighting JDL-ST-55-14 is a 14W twin head recessed LED spotlight with two square light openings in a visible 115 × 64 mm trim. Its ivory white and titanium gold finish can be coordinated with interior finishes, while a CRI of 97 or higher supports accurate color rendering on merchandise, textiles and display surfaces.

Specify a 10° or 15° beam for a concentrated accent, or choose 24°, 36° or 50° for wider coverage. Color temperature options are 3000K, 4000K and 6000K. The fixture is 75 mm high, requires a 105 × 55 mm ceiling cutout and has a specified input of 220 V. For a project quote, share your preferred beam angle, color temperature and quantity.

Key Features

  • 14W twin head design with two square light openings
  • 115 × 64 mm visible trim
  • CRI ≥97 for accurate color rendering
  • 10°, 15°, 24°, 36° and 50° beam options
  • 3000K, 4000K and 6000K options
  • 105 × 55 mm ceiling cutout
